title: 第17章 烧烤摊支起第18章 大王派我来巡山
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
陈广盯着落尘，表情变得肃穆：
“落尘，下面我说的话你任何人也不能告诉，否则咱俩都活不成。
我不知道你得罪了什么大人物，上面下令把你发配到这里。
到这里的弟子没有一个活着回去的，这是借刀杀人，让你自生自灭。
在这里十死无生。
你能跑就跑吧，离宗门远点躲起来。
宗门不会为一个杂役弟子大动干戈的，这样，你也许能捡条命。”
落尘怔住了，这是什么情况，还有人想害他？
但他看出陈广绝对不是撒谎，也没有必要撒谎，不禁皱起了眉头。
想了半晌也没想到得罪了谁。
他非常郑重地给陈广行个礼，开口道：
“陈叔，谢谢您提醒。
我刚到宗门一天，几乎没接触什么人，真想不起来能得罪谁。
不过，我以后会注意的。
这个地方很好，我不会离开的。
谁要是害我，我也绝对不会让他好过。”
“你怎么不听劝呢，这里就是死路一条……”
“我不怕，我要在这里种上千亩灵田。
人也好，妖兽也好，谁欺负我，我就把他剁了！”
“你，你还是逃跑吧，不但是为了自己，想想家里的父母……”

“我没父母了，我也坚决不跑……”
……
俩人说了半天，陈广最终也没说服落尘，无奈地摇摇头。
掏出几张灵符说道：
“落尘，我也不劝你了，但愿你能活下去。
我送你两张疾行符、两张爆炎符。
疾行符撕开封印贴在腿上，速度可以提高一倍。
爆炎符扔出可以爆炸起火，对筑基期的也有威胁。”
这是陈广压箱底的东西，平时都舍不得用。
“谢谢陈叔，这可是好东西。”
落尘连忙接过来。
虽然他现在对灵符不了解，但也知道这几张灵符关键时候可以保命，内心对陈广感激不尽。
陈广又啰嗦了很多注意事项和保命的方法，见落尘修炼一途一无所知，又送了几本关于天玄大陆和修炼方面的书。
content_en:
Chen Guang stared at Luochen, his expression becoming solemn:
"Luochen, no one can tell you what I'm going to say next, otherwise neither of us will survive.
I don't know what big shot you offended, and the higher-ups ordered you to be sent here.
None of the disciples who came here came back alive. This is killing someone with a borrowed knife, leaving you to fend for yourself.
There is no life or death here.
Run if you can, stay away from the sect and hide.
The sect will not go to war over a handyman disciple. In this way, you may be able to save your life. "
Luochen was stunned. What was going on? Someone else wanted to harm him?
But he saw that Chen Guang was definitely not lying, and there was no need to lie, so he couldn't help but frown.
After thinking about it for a long time, I didn't think about whom I had offended.
He saluted Chen Guang very solemnly and said:
"Uncle Chen, thank you for reminding me.
I had just arrived at the sect for a day and had barely interacted with anyone. I really couldn’t think of anyone I could offend.
However, I will pay attention to it in the future.
This place is great and I won't leave.
If anyone harms me, I will never make it easy for him. "
"Why don't you listen to my advice? This is a dead end..."
"I'm not afraid, I want to plant thousands of acres of spiritual land here.
Whether it's a human being or a monster, whoever bullies me, I'll chop him into pieces! "
"You, you should run away, not only for yourself, but also for your parents at home..."
"I have no parents, and I am determined not to run away..."
…
The two talked for a long time, but Chen Guang finally failed to convince Luochen and shook his head helplessly.
He took out a few talismans and said:
"Luochen, I won't advise you anymore, I hope you can survive.
I'll give you two Speedy Talisman and two Explosive Flame Talisman.
If you tear off the seal and stick it on your leg, your speed can be doubled.
Throwing the Explosive Flame Talisman can explode and cause fire, which is also a threat to those in the foundation building stage. "
This is something that Chen Guang keeps at the bottom of his box and is reluctant to use.
"Thank you, Uncle Chen, this is good stuff."
Luochen quickly took it over.
Although he doesn't know much about spiritual talismans now, he also knows that these spiritual talismans can save his life at critical moments, and he is deeply grateful to Chen Guang.
Chen Guang went on to talk a lot about precautions and life-saving methods. Seeing that Luochen knew nothing about his cultivation, he also gave him a few books about Tianxuan Continent and cultivation.
